name: Gaston's Escargot Gratinée (Avoid in Flares)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Wonder · Triton's
whyItWorks: Chewy snail meat, finely chopped indigestible mushrooms, and a heavy pool of garlic-herb butter combine tough texture with high fat and FODMAPs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares. In solid remission, dip a small piece of French bread into the melted herb butter rather than eating the chewy snails and mushrooms.
flareEmergencySwap: Order the Iced Lobster and Jumbo Shrimp or Potage Parmentier (smooth leek and potato soup) instead.
watchOuts: Chewy snail texture and chopped mushrooms
